subject: Implement F1 nrows=2 kernel in kernel-lab
description: x2 kernel: shared activation loads (4 vle8 + 4 vneg per block) + per-row vlm/vmerge/vwredsum/pack + shared vlse16 scale vector, two facc accumulators. Check ggml-cpu.c mul_mat nrc=2 calling convention (s/bs/bx strides) from an existing nrc=2 kernel first. Add harness entries comparing x2 vs two generic calls, verify all VLENs, QEMU + vsim bench.
